notes: The social analytics export no longer executes on DELETE: that verb returns 405, while GET ?export=true is separately steward-gated. The export rejects invalid format/date windows and refuses oversized results rather than silently truncating them; CSV remains formula-neutralized and account follower columns now map correctly. A mandatory tenant-bound audit is persisted before any CSV/JSON response; audit failures return 503 without exporting data. Both response types prohibit caching. Source and regression tests are committed but executable and runtime qualification are pending.

Exact-HEAD focused and full Vitest/contract, native PostgreSQL 15/16 with real RLS and audit storage, HTTP/browser/staging acceptance, and institutional decision on export audience remain outstanding. Campaign export still uses bounded per-campaign queries and needs scalable server-side aggregation; no production acceptance claimed.
